Safdarjung's Tomb

A 105-minute heritage walk in Lodhi Road, Delhi

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you study late Mughal funerary architecture and the garden setting.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Main gate
  • Garden quadrants
  • Tomb plinth
  • Exit interpretation

How the time is spent

  1. Main gate 20 min

    Explain late-Mughal political context and axial entry.

    You: locate axes

  2. Garden quadrants 35 min

    Discuss charbagh adaptation and landscape change.

    You: sketch plan

  3. Tomb plinth 30 min

    Inspect marble/sandstone contrast.

    You: record materials

  4. Exit interpretation 20 min

    Discuss patronage, maintenance and colonial histories.

    You: compare Humayun template

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Safdarjung’s Tomb using material evidence and a site map.
  • Study late Mughal funerary architecture and the garden setting.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.
